dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you repeating your own name?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Oh, you heard that? Ah, it's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I'm simply lamenting the past, lamenting a friend that has passed...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I'm doing. Why would I lie about it?
